Trump Grants Visa to Mother of Bronx Shooting Victim After Call

President Donald Trump has agreed to grant a visa to the mother of a Ghanaian teenager who was killed in a shooting in the Bronx, according to political activist and former presidential candidate Adamawa Mamdani. Mamdani stated that Trump agreed to the visa after a phone call between the two.
